headline: RBI issues Local Area Banks (KYC) Second Amendment Directions, 2026
reference: Reserve Bank of India (Local Area Banks - Know Your Customer) Second Amendment Directions, 2026
summary_points: RBI has published the Local Area Banks - Know Your Customer Second Amendment Directions, 2026 on its Notifications page.
The Directions amend the existing KYC framework applicable to Local Area Banks.
The text available here shows only the title; the substantive amendments, issue date and effective date are not visible.
Read the full notification (PDF, about 238 kb) on the RBI website for the exact changes.
who_is_affected: Local Area Banks and their customers and compliance teams dealing with KYC and customer due diligence requirements.
action_required: Download the full Directions from the RBI website, compare them with the current KYC policy and update procedures as required.
